title: Code Immersives / Digital Film Academy
summary: A 900-hour web development immersive focused on the MERN stack and AWS.
body:
### Full-stack development

Completed a 900-hour immersive focused on the MERN stack and AWS. Selected work from my web development portfolio brings together interactive frontends, APIs, databases, and deployment.

- [Construct Snippets — frontend](https://github.com/nlbdotdev/construct-snippets-frontend) / [backend](https://github.com/nlbdotdev/construct-snippets-backend): a full-stack snippet library with authentication and session management.
- [React Ticket Tracker — frontend](https://github.com/nlbdotdev/react-ticket-frontend) / [backend](https://github.com/nlbdotdev/react-ticket-backend): task and issue tracking with React, Redux, and a Node backend.
- [Portfolio](https://nlb.dev) / [source](https://github.com/nlbdotdev/Portfolio): my personal Svelte portfolio, originally a frontend capstone and since evolved into this site.
- [Code Immersives coursework](https://github.com/nlbdotdev/CodeImmersives): exercises and projects from the program.

Images show the original project interfaces, including the earlier portfolio design.
